_: The boons a people carries: what a filter overcome well leaves behind. The simulation reads the key; the view reads name and desc.
boons: one row per boon: key; name (how the legends say it); desc (what it is in the world).
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.

boons.name: aligned minds
boons.desc: aligned minds: the thinking machines a people made stayed its own, and think with it

boons.name: swarm industry
boons.desc: swarm industry: the self-replicating machines a people made stayed in hand, and build for it

boons.name: unity forged in the atomic age
boons.desc: unity forged in the atomic age: the people that came through the bomb without using it is one people after

boons.name: communion with something older
boons.desc: communion with something older: the people talked to an elder thing and was answered

boons.name: a sun held together
boons.desc: a sun held together: the people knew star lifting when its sun began to fail, and kept the star burning
